The plate looks like a square dinner plate, about 26 cm across. It holds brown rice with spinach, peppers and flaked salmon, plus two salmon pieces (fillet portions) on the side.

I estimate the rice at about 150 g, or roughly 1 cup cooked, which comes to around 200 kcal. The salmon is about 2 pieces at roughly 80 g each, so 160 g, which comes to around 300 kcal when cooked with oil. The vegetables and oil add about 30 g and around 50 kcal.

That gives about 340 g of food and about 550 kcal.
